تستقدسوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِسُوا (tastaqdisū) /tas.taq.di.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
# تُسْتَقْدَسُوا (tustaqdasū) /tus.taq.da.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
